index.description: L2 index of methodologies in the automation-tooling domain. The retriever reads this after picking automation-tooling from L1 domains.xml. Entries list slug + tier + summary, plus any <assumes> from the leaf's meta.json — a methodology to load first, and why. Open the leaf meta.json / content/*.xml for full payload.

methodology.summary: Generates a Playwright test or scraping script using role-based locators, auto-wait, storageState auth reuse, and on-first-retry trace capture.
methodology.assumes: shares Playwright Test runner conventions and reporter setup
alternative — read to confirm Playwright is the right tool

methodology.summary: Produces a backend service scaffold in Go/Rails/Laravel/Spring Boot/.NET/Rust enforcing the canonical layout, error model, DI shape, and async discipline for the chosen language.
methodology.assumes: shared test runner conventions per language
scaffolded service must pass the CI gate

methodology.summary: Produces Django app code that uses fat-model thin-view discipline, custom QuerySet managers, select_related/prefetch_related to kill N+1, atomic transactions on writes, and class-based views/DRF for HTTP boundaries.
methodology.assumes: shared Python tooling: ruff, mypy, pyproject.toml
tests use pytest-django fixtures and factories

methodology.summary: Produces a frontend component (React, Vue, Svelte, or Angular) following one-responsibility, typed props, accessibility-from-the-start, controlled-vs-uncontrolled separation, and CSS-isolation discipline.
methodology.assumes: shared TS config and lint rules
shared component test runner + Testing Library usage

methodology.summary: Produces a JS/TS project baseline: strict tsconfig, ESLint flat config + Prettier, Vitest, exports map, ESM-only, type-checked CI step.
methodology.assumes: package manager defaults — pnpm preferred
Vitest conventions for UI work

methodology.summary: Produces a Python project baseline: pyproject.toml with ruff + mypy strict, uv/pip-tools lock, src/ layout, py.typed marker, pre-commit hooks, CI gate.
methodology.assumes: shares pytest conventions; out-of-scope here

methodology.summary: Produces a Puppeteer worker script that the agent invokes via Bash with a hard timeout, captures structured artifacts to disk, and never runs browser logic inline in the LLM turn.
methodology.assumes: config knobs and headless flags
selector + wait discipline
artifact shapes and quality settings

methodology.summary: Produces a Puppeteer launch config + navigation wrapper with correct CI/Docker flags, pinned Chromium revision, finally-close discipline, and SPA-safe wait strategies.
methodology.assumes: this config is what the worker uses

methodology.summary: Produces a Puppeteer capture script that takes screenshots (jpeg/webp quality 80 for high volume), PDFs (printBackground true + waitForSelector before pdf), and HAR (with secret scrubber).
methodology.assumes: the page handed in came from the safe launch wrapper
artifacts get scrubbed before persistence

methodology.summary: Produces a Puppeteer interaction layer using attribute-based selectors (data-testid/id/name), targeted waitForSelector instead of waitForTimeout, request interception for stable scraping, and form fills via type/select/check methods.
methodology.assumes: page handed in came from safe launch wrapper
this code runs inside a Bash worker

methodology.summary: Produces a Puppeteer session layer using userDataDir per logical identity, explicit cookie serialisation as a secondary mechanism, isolated browser contexts per parallel job, and a daemonised runner for long-lived sessions.
methodology.assumes: launch wrapper invoked with userDataDir option
long-lived sessions live behind a queue, never inline

methodology.summary: Produces a Puppeteer stealth + proxy layer using one documented evasion stance (plugin or manual, never both), proxy rotation with circuit breaker on 4xx, and bounded retries.
methodology.assumes: launch wrapper accepts proxy + extra args
worker exits non-zero with status on circuit breaker

methodology.summary: Test-suite scaffolding per backend language using each ecosystem's idiomatic runner — RSpec, Pest, xUnit, tokio::test, JUnit slices — with the scope discipline that keeps full-application bootstraps off by default.
methodology.assumes: code-side patterns the tests verify
CI gate runs these tests on every push

methodology.summary: Produces Django pytest tests using function style + @pytest.mark.django_db + factory_boy factories, parametrize for input variants, shallow mocks, and conftest.py that does not call ORM directly.
methodology.assumes: code under test follows fat-model thin-view + service-layer rules
shared pyproject + ruff + mypy + pre-commit

methodology.summary: Produces frontend component tests using @testing-library + Vitest (or Jest), querying by accessible role/label/text, explicit imports from 'vitest' (or globals:true), no snapshot-by-default, and runner-pinned mock APIs.
methodology.assumes: the component being tested follows the practices methodology
TS strict + ESLint flat config + Vitest configured

methodology.summary: Produces a Branch-by-Abstraction plan that follows the five steps (Protocol → wrap old → implement new → flag-gated swap → remove old + collapse abstraction), with a step-5 cleanup ticket filed at step-1 merge time.
methodology.assumes: feature-flag mechanics live there; BbA composes with it
trunk stays green during the migration

methodology.summary: Produces a diagnostic report when trunk breaks repeatedly, applying an ordered checklist (gates → CI speed → flags → PR size → review SLA) and recommending the first failing fix before touching downstream symptoms.
methodology.assumes: patterns being audited
the gates that should already exist

methodology.summary: Produces a CI configuration enforcing trunk-based gates: pre-commit hooks under 1s, CI under 10 minutes, branch protection with full required-status list, auto-revert on red trunk, and a verifier that the required-status list stays in sync with CI job names.
methodology.assumes: patterns these gates enforce
pre-commit hook ecosystem if Python

methodology.summary: Produces a trunk-based pattern plan using feature flags, branch by abstraction, and dark launching — with cleanup tickets, positive flag naming, < 24h branch lifetimes, and < 1% dark-launch ramp before scaling.
methodology.assumes: CI + branch protection + auto-revert in place
BbA mechanics for staged refactors

methodology.summary: Produces an Unattended Automation Record deciding whether an automation runtime is warranted at all — usually it is not — and, when it is, the cheapest surface that can express the trigger: agent hooks, then the OS scheduler, then a self-hosted workflow runtime. Carries the dated per-tool exec-capability table that eliminates most visual tools outright when a local binary must run.
